{{Quote|My instructions say flitter 555 is already rented in my name... and I'm to take it!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="GW" />}}
'''Flitter 555''' was a [[flitter cab]] on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. It was rented in [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] name as part of an elaborate plan to shake [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] surveillance so Luke could meet with [[President/Legends|President]] [[Natala Vanden]] on behalf of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
